name: Mad Hatter
source:
Based off of the Mad Hatter from Carroll's [i]Alice in Wonderland[/i]. She is mad, stuck in teatime with her two dearest friends, the Dormouse and March Hare, puppet facsimiles on her hands. She aids Alice on a quest to collect them all—limbs that is!

The Hatter's goal is to get revenge on the Red Queen, but how can she do it with the Red Queen dismembered?

[From [url=https://vnstudioelan.com/bellhouse/who-is-the-red-queen/]official website[/url]]
